coaching.label: Coaching
lookFor: Every player gets lots of touches
Keeps the group moving, little standing around

questions.q: Walk us through how you planned today’s session.
questions.listen: A clear goal, progression from simple to game-like

questions.q: A player is upset after being benched. What do you do?
questions.listen: Empathy, talking to the player first, involving parents calmly

questions.q: How do you keep families in the loop during a season?
questions.listen: Regular, simple updates through CLP Messages

questions.q: What would your first month with this team look like?
questions.listen: Getting to know players, setting standards, realistic goals

officiating.label: Officiating
lookFor: Knows the laws of the game
Handles coaches and parents with respect

questions.q: Tell us about a tough call you made and how you handled the reaction.
questions.listen: Composure, explaining briefly, not arguing

questions.q: How do you prepare on a game day?
questions.listen: Arrives early, checks the field and gear, knows the rules of the event

questions.q: A coach keeps shouting at a young player’s mistakes. What do you do?
questions.listen: Steps in calmly, protects the player, reports if it goes on

questions.q: Which days and how many games can you do in a weekend?
questions.listen: Realistic availability, reliable

events.label: Events & operations
lookFor: Stays calm when it gets busy
Speaks up when something is unsafe

questions.q: Tell us about a busy event you worked. What was your job?
questions.listen: Clear role, took ownership, worked with the team

questions.q: A parent is angry about a schedule change. What do you do?
questions.listen: Listens, stays calm, finds the right person

questions.q: You notice a safety problem near a field. What happens next?
questions.listen: Acts at once, tells the lead, keeps people clear

questions.q: Which dates can you work, and can you be there early?
questions.listen: Matches the event days, reliable

health.label: Health & performance
lookFor: Holds the right licence or certification

questions.q: How do you build a plan for a young athlete in season?
questions.listen: Load management, age-appropriate, talks to the coach

questions.q: An athlete says they’re fine but you think they’re hurt. What do you do?
questions.listen: Safety first, follows protocol, involves guardians

questions.q: How do you keep notes and share them with the team?
questions.listen: Private, organised, shares only what is needed

questions.q: Which certifications do you hold, and when do they expire?
questions.listen: Current and verifiable

questions.q: Tell us about a time you helped a customer who was upset.
questions.listen: Patience, owns the problem, follows up

questions.q: How do you open or close a building safely?
questions.listen: Checklists, locks, lights, reports problems

questions.q: A child is waiting and no one has come to pick them up. What do you do?
questions.listen: Stays with them, follows the pick-up policy, calls the contact

questions.q: Which shifts can you cover?
questions.listen: Matches the schedule, reliable

media.label: Media & content
lookFor: Knows where to stand and when
Respects rules on photos of minors

questions.q: Walk us through your portfolio. Which shot are you proudest of?
questions.listen: Timing, storytelling, technical control

questions.q: How fast can you deliver edited photos after a game?
questions.listen: Realistic turnaround, organised workflow

questions.q: A parent asks you not to photograph their child. What do you do?
questions.listen: Respects it at once, tells the lead, removes any shots

questions.q: What gear do you bring, and what do you need from us?
questions.listen: Prepared, clear about needs

office.label: Marketing, sales & office
lookFor: Curious about sport and our community

questions.q: Tell us about a project you led from idea to result.
questions.listen: Ownership, a measurable result, learning

questions.q: How would you grow sign-ups for a youth program?
questions.listen: Knows the audience, simple practical ideas

questions.q: How do you keep track of many tasks and people?
questions.listen: Tools, routines, follows up

questions.q: What do you want to learn in this role?
questions.listen: Clear goals that fit the role

questions.q: Tell us about machines or tools you’ve run before.
questions.listen: Relevant experience, safety habits

questions.q: You notice a batch has a mistake. What do you do?
questions.listen: Stops, tells the lead, does not ship it

questions.q: How do you keep your area safe and tidy?
questions.listen: Routines, reports hazards

questions.q: Which shifts can you work?
questions.listen: Matches the schedule, reliable
